subtitle: David and Solomon
text_1981: And David and Solomon, when they once ruled with regard to someone's crop that was destroyed by another's sheep. We witnessed their judgment.
text_1989: And David and Solomon once ruled with regard to someone’s crop that was destroyed by another’s sheep. We witnessed their judgment.
text_ref: And David and Solomon, when they once ruled with regard to someone's crop that was destroyed by another's sheep. We witnessed their judgment.

text_1981: We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to serve David in glorifying (GOD), as well as the birds. This is what we did.
text_1989: We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. mountains to glorify (God) and to serve David, as well as the birds. This is what we did.
text_ref: We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to serve David in glorifying (GOD), as well as the birds. This is what we did.

text_1981: And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?
text_1989: And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?
text_ref: And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?

text_1981: For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing at his disposal. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.
text_1989: For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing in his service. and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.
text_ref: For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing at his disposal. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.

text_1981: And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We committed them in his service.
text_1989: And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We kept them in his service.
text_ref: And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We committed them in his service.

subtitle: Job
text_1981: And Job implored his Lord: "Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."
text_1989: And Job implored his Lord: “Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful.”
text_ref: And Job implored his Lord: "Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."

text_1981: We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, even twice as much. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.
text_1989: We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, and doubled them. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.
text_ref: We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, even twice as much. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.

text_1981: Also, Ismail, Idrîs, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.
text_1989: Also, Ismail, Idris, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.
text_ref: Also, Ismail, Idrîs, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.

text_1981: We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.
text_1989: We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.
text_ref: We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.

subtitle: Jonah
text_1981: And Zan-Noon (Jonah, "the one with an 'N' in his name"), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish's belly): "There is no god other than You. Be You glorified. I have committed a gross sin."
text_1989: And Zan-Noon (Jonah, “the one with an ‘N’ in his name”), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish’s belly): “There is no other god besides You. glorified.
text_ref: And Zan-Noon (Jonah, "the one with an 'N' in his name"), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish's belly): "There is no god other than You. Be You glorified. I have committed a gross sin."

text_1981: We responded to him, and saved him from the crisis; we thus save the believers.
text_1989: We responded to him, and saved him from misery; we thus save the believers.
text_ref: We responded to him, and saved him from the crisis; we thus save the believers.

subtitle: Zachariah and John
text_1981: And Zachariah implored his Lord: "My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor."
text_1989: And Zachariah implored his Lord: “My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor.”
text_ref: And Zachariah implored his Lord: "My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor."

text_1981: We* responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they used to hasten to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
footnote_1981: *21:90 The use of the plural tense throughout the Quran indicates participation of the angels. It is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10.
text_1989: We* responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they always hastened to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
footnote_1989: *21:90 The use of the plural tense throughout Quran indicates participation of the angels. For example, it is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10. 0 1618 The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:91-101 330 r-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Mary and Jesus
text_ref: We* responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they used to hasten to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
footnote_ref: *21:90 The use of the plural tense throughout the Quran indicates participation of the angels. It is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10.

subtitle: Mary and Jesus
text_1981: As for the one who maintained her virginity, we blew into her from our spirit, and thus, we made her and her son a portent for the whole world.
text_1989: And (recall) the one who maintained her virginity, then we blew into her from our spirit. We rendered her and her son a sign for the whole world.
text_ref: As for the one who maintained her virginity, we blew into her from our spirit, and thus, we made her and her son a portent for the whole world.

subtitle: One God / One Religion
text_1981: Your congregation is but one congregation, and I alone am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.
text_1989: Such (are the messengers of) your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.
text_ref: Your congregation is but one congregation, and I alone am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.

text_1981: However, they divided themselves into disputing religions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).
text_1989: Unfortunately, they divided themselves into disputing factions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).
text_ref: However, they divided themselves into disputing religions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).

text_1981: As for those who work righteousness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.
text_1989: As for those who work righteous­ ness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.
text_ref: As for those who work righteousness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.

text_1981: It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.
text_1989: It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.
text_ref: It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.

subtitle: The End of the World*
text_1981: Not until Gog and Magog reappear,* will they then return—they will come from every direction.
footnote_1981: *21:96 By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God's mathematical miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1), America will be the heart of Submission, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog (allegorical names of villainous communities), will be the only bastions of heathenism, and they will attack the submitters. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). Gog and Magog are mentioned in 18:94 & 21:96, 17 verses before the end of each sura; this may indicate the time of their appearance.
text_1989: Not until Gog and Magog reap­ pear,* will they then return—they will come from every direction.
footnote_1989: *21:96 By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God’s mathematical miracle in the Quran (Ap­ pendix 1), America will be the heart of Islam, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog, will be the only bas­ tions of heathenism, and they will attack the Muslims. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). God has not yet revealed the identity of Gog and Magog. 1 1619 The Prophets (Al-Anbyaa’) 21:102-112
text_ref: Not until Gog and Magog reappear,* will they then return—they will come from every direction.
footnote_ref: *21:96 By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God's mathematical miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1), America will be the heart of Submission, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog (allegorical names of villainous communities), will be the only bastions of heathenism, and they will attack the submitters. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). Gog and Magog are mentioned in 18:94 & 21:96, 17 verses before the end of each sura; this may indicate the time of their appearance.

text_1981: That is when the inevitable prophecy will come to pass, and the disbelievers will stare in horror: "Woe to us; we have been oblivious. Indeed, we have been wicked."
text_1989: That is when the fulfillment of the truthful promise will approach. disbelievers will stare in horror: “Woe to us. this.
text_ref: That is when the inevitable prophecy will come to pass, and the disbelievers will stare in horror: "Woe to us; we have been oblivious. Indeed, we have been wicked."

subtitle: The Hereafter
text_1981: You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.
text_1989: You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.
text_ref: You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.

text_1981: If those were gods, they would not have ended up in Hell. All its inhabitants abide in it forever.
text_1989: If these were gods, they would not have ended in Hell. therein forever.
text_ref: If those were gods, they would not have ended up in Hell. All its inhabitants abide in it forever.

text_1981: They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to any news.
text_1989: They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to anything, while they abide therein.
text_ref: They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to any news.

text_1981: As for those who deserved our magnificent rewards, they will be protected from it.
text_1989: As for those who deserved beautiful rewards from us, they will be protected.
text_ref: As for those who deserved our magnificent rewards, they will be protected from it.

subtitle: The Righteous
text_1981: They will not hear its hissing. They will enjoy an abode where they can get everything they desire, forever.
text_1989: They will not hear its hissing. They will abide in everything they desire, forever.
text_ref: They will not hear its hissing. They will enjoy an abode where they can get everything they desire, forever.

text_1981: The great horror will not worry them, and the angels will receive them joyfully: "This is your day, that has been promised to you."
text_1989: The great horror will not worry them, for the angels will receive them joyfully: “This is your day, that has been promised to you.”
text_ref: The great horror will not worry them, and the angels will receive them joyfully: "This is your day, that has been promised to you."

subtitle: The Day of Resurrection
text_1981: On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as we initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. This is our promise; we will certainly carry it out.
text_1989: On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. we will certainly carry it out.
text_ref: On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as we initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. This is our promise; we will certainly carry it out.

text_1981: We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scriptures, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.
text_1989: We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scripture, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.
text_ref: We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scriptures, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.

text_1981: This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.
text_1989: This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.
text_ref: This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.

text_1981: We have sent you out of mercy from us towards the whole world.
text_1989: We have sent you (O Muhammad) out of mercy from us towards the whole world.
text_ref: We have sent you out of mercy from us towards the whole world.

text_1981: Proclaim, "I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god. Will you then submit?"
text_1989: Proclaim, “I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god.
text_ref: Proclaim, "I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god. Will you then submit?"

text_1981: If they turn away, then say, "I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.
text_1989: If they turn away, then say, “I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.
text_ref: If they turn away, then say, "I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.

text_1981: "He is fully aware of your public utterances, and He is fully aware of everything you conceal.
text_1989: “He is the only One who knows your public utterances, and He knows whatever you conceal.
text_ref: "He is fully aware of your public utterances, and He is fully aware of everything you conceal.

text_1981: "For all that I know, this world is a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment."
text_1989: “I have no idea; this may be a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment.”
text_ref: "For all that I know, this world is a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment."

text_1981: Say, "My Lord, Your judgment is the absolute justice. Our Lord is the Most Gracious; only His help is sought in the face of your claims."
text_1989: Say, “My Lord, You judge equitably. only His help is sought in the face of your claims.” -T— : - ' 331 ' ~ >
text_ref: Say, "My Lord, Your judgment is the absolute justice. Our Lord is the Most Gracious; only His help is sought in the face of your claims."
